app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The product-catalog service is returning an internal error for certain product lookups (observed for product id "OLJCESPC7Z"). Traces show multiple gRPC responses with status 13 (INTERNAL) and the span-level error description "Error: Product Catalog Fail" coming from product-catalog. This service-level failure is the direct cause of 500 responses seen at the frontend/frontend-proxy. (Note: product-catalog pod has a very small Go memory cap GOMEMLIMIT=16Mi and small container memory limit of 32Mi and its logs show OTLP exporter timeouts, but the immediate failure mechanism seen in traces is product-catalog returning INTERNAL errors for the product lookup.)
